50-70+: Golem’s Temple III ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐. Golem Prison is one of the most iconic spots for Hunters to train. Arrow Bomb can hit almost the entire cluster of Mixed Golems just by standing on the first stoney platform. Golems can buff their attack, which can deal up to 600 touch damage. They drop 60% Bow for ATT and 60% Gloves for ATT scrolls, which are extremely vital for your future progression. Other notable drops include the level 50 Bowman overall and level 60 hat.
